_doc: Wally's World battle sprite roster: every fighter, enemy and boss mapped to a sprite, with briefs for the artist. Source of truth for enemies.json spriteId and sprites.json; brief and apply with ../voice-rpg-engine/scripts/sprite_roster.py wallys-world [--apply]. Spec: ../voice-rpg-engine/docs/SPRITE_PLAN.md.
title: Wally's World
summary: A memoir told as a JRPG: eight years and five states inside a big-box retailer, its freight trenches, service bays and offices. The party is Todd and Adriana; most enemies are the forces of the job made into monsters (the freight wall, the fluorescent hum, the poisoned email, the dashboard), and the bosses are the managers and machines of the company. Keep the humans grounded and recognisable from `app/src/main/assets/portraits/` (Wally's associates wear a teal vest with orange piping and a yellow smiley badge); make the abstract enemies strange and readable, ordinary workplace objects with a face, limbs and menace, like the existing 20x26 sprites they replace. Tone: weary, sincere, darkly funny, never cartoonish about the hard moments.
style_extra: Store palette: teal and orange uniforms, fluorescent white-green light, concrete grey, safety yellow; the service bays add oil black, tire rubber and red tool chests.
Abstract enemies: an object first (a box stack, a monitor, a memo) with one or two features that make it alive (eyes, a mouth, arms); keep each silhouette distinct at 64 px.

party.name: Todd, Hourly Associate
party.look: Todd from portraits/todd.jpg in his first years: tired eyes with dark circles, messy brown hair, stubble, the teal Wally's vest with orange piping and a smiley badge over a grey T-shirt, work gloves, jeans and steel-toe boots; a box cutter on a lanyard. Determined slouch of someone on hour nine of an unload.
party.moves: charge: plants his feet and breathes through it, shoulders rising; cast: throws a hand forward, a wave of willpower (release=4); attack: Freight Push, shoulder-drives forward as if moving a pallet; ko: drops to one knee, then sits against a box; victory: wipes his forehead, a small tired smile.

party.name: Todd, Shop Manager
party.look: The same Todd years later running the auto service bays: navy mechanic's work shirt with the sleeves rolled, the smiley badge on the chest pocket, grease on the forearms, a heavy pneumatic impact wrench in one hand, a shop rag in the back pocket, steel-toe boots. More confident stance than the associate.
party.moves: charge: the impact wrench spins up, sparks at the socket; cast: Volt Snap / Coolant Chill / Bay Heat, points the wrench like a wand and a jet of sparks, coolant or heat shoots out (release=4); attack: Tire Grind, swings a tire iron or rolls a tire into the foe; ko: slumps against a tool chest; victory: spins the wrench and holsters it.

party.name: Adriana
party.look: Adriana from portraits/adriana.jpg: long dark wavy hair, warm brown eyes, a tan cardigan over a soft grey top, jeans; calm, grounded posture. Her 'weapon' is steadiness itself: a warm golden shield of light she can raise (Unbroken Aegis) and a coffee mug she never spills.
party.moves: charge: hand over heart, eyes closed, golden light gathering; cast: Lifeline Mend / Steady Presence, opens her hands and a warm gold glow flows forward (release=4); attack: Truth Smite, points and a clean beam of light strikes; ko: kneels, still upright; victory: a relieved smile, mug raised.

party.name: Adriana's Inspiration
party.look: Adriana as she fights beside Todd from far away (36 encounters): a translucent, softly glowing golden version of her, hovering a few pixels above the floor.

families.name: Shift Simulator
families.look: A battered training mannequin on a wheeled base wearing a teal vest, a laminated 'new hire' card on a lanyard, a blank face with a drawn-on smiley. Used by the voice tutorial.
families.moves: attack: rocks forward on its base; death: tips over and rolls away.

families.name: The Freight Wall
families.look: A hulking golem built from stacked cardboard freight boxes and a broken pallet base, shrink-wrap trailing like torn skin, two dark gaps between boxes for eyes, box-flap arms. Leans forward like it's about to topple onto you.
families.moves: attack: slams down with a box-stack arm; cast: shrink-wrap lashes out; windup: the stack sways.

families.name: The Fluorescent Hum
families.look: The enemy in almost every fight: a long fluorescent tube creature hanging from a broken ceiling fixture on two chains, its ballast box a jaw that buzzes, cold white-green light flickering in waves along the tube, sparks at the ends. Floats; its lowest point is the fixture's dangling chain.
families.moves: cast: Sigil Pulse, the tube strobes and a pulse of cold light rolls out; attack: Grinding Slab, swings down on its chains; idle: a slow flicker, the hum visible as little vibration lines.

families.name: The Dashboard
families.look: A wall monitor on a rolling stand come alive: the screen a face of red and green gauges and a jagged line graph for a mouth, power cables for arms. The Hour-Occupancy Gauge, always in the red.
families.moves: cast and attack: Bolt Volley / Suppressive Fire, the screen flashes and fires red metric bars like bolts.

members.variant: the Register Blitz: a POS register screen, every lane light blazing red

families.name: The Ringer
families.look: Management's pet: a smug floor lead in a pressed teal vest, a phone handset on a coiled cord swung like a whip (the 'paging wand'), a clipboard tucked under the arm, chin up.
families.moves: attack: lashes the handset cord; cast: War Cry, shouts into the handset and a page blares out.

families.name: The Poisoned Email
families.look: A floating envelope-phantom: an open email window with a sickly purple glow, the envelope flap a fanged mouth, a cursor for an eye, a trailing tail of 'Reply All' threads. Hovers.
families.moves: cast: Void Bolt / Siphon Essence, spits a purple message bolt; attack: Enveloping Dark, wraps around the target.

families.name: The Bay Grime
families.look: A creeping slab of oil-soaked concrete grime: a black, glistening sludge mound with a boot half-swallowed in it, rainbow oil sheen, a drain grate for a mouth.
families.moves: attack: rears up and slaps down; windup: bubbles.

families.name: The Queue Wall
families.look: Bodies pressing forward: a lumpy wall of impatient shoppers fused into one mass, many arms holding receipts, phones and return bags, several mouths open mid-complaint.
families.moves: attack: the whole mass surges forward; cast: War Cry, a roar of complaints.

members.variant: the Friday Rush: a line of service customers with pickup-truck headlights glaring behind them (a separate sheet with a truck would sell it better)

families.name: The Sixth in Line
families.look: A single impatient shopper: phone held up, foot tapping, a full cart handle under one hand, a number ticket in the other.
families.moves: attack: Aimed Shot, flings the number ticket; cast: Volley Shot, a barrage of 'Excuse me?'s as little speech-burst sparks (no text).

members.variant: the Grab-and-Run: a hooded shoplifter mid-sprint with an armful of electronics

families.name: The Tire Tower
families.look: A teetering stack of mounted tires (rims and all) that has learned to walk: lug-nut eyes glinting from the top tire, a tire-iron arm, tread marks down its sides.
families.moves: attack: Crush, topples its top tires onto the target; cast: Steam Vent, the valve stems hiss.

families.name: The Retirement Memo
families.look: A tall, polite sheet of company letterhead with a red wax seal for a heart, folded paper arms, a neat corporate signature curling like a smile. Polite corporate execution.
families.moves: cast: Void Bolt, fires paper cuts; attack: wraps the target like an envelope.

families.name: The Watchful Eye
families.look: A ceiling security camera dome on a tripod of cables, one red lens eye that never blinks, a little red recording light pulsing.
families.moves: cast and attack: Bolt Volley, flashes and fires a red scan beam.

members.variant: the Hostile Floor: two lenses on one stalk, one warm and one cold (two faces, one spine)

families.name: The Grievance File
families.look: A fat manila file folder walking on its spine, papers spilling like a tongue, a red 'UNSUBSTANTIATED' rubber stamp for a fist (stamp face blank, no text).
families.moves: attack: Thorn Lash, slams the stamp; cast: Choking Pollen, a puff of loose paper.

members.variant: the Claim Blizzard: icy white, loose forms swirling around it
the Unrealistic Standard: a red folder with a graph arrow shooting straight up

families.name: The Blotter Regulars
families.look: A weather system of theft: a whirling funnel of torn price tags, empty hangers and blotter clippings with two hooded silhouettes inside it.
families.moves: cast: Bramble Whip, the funnel lashes out; attack: sweeps across like a gust.

families.name: The Calibration Lapse
families.look: A service-bay torque wrench and pressure gauge fused into a gangly creature, a peeling expired calibration sticker over one eye, sparking at the joints.
families.moves: cast: Bolt Volley, the gauge needle snaps and fires sparks.

families.name: The Bay Debt
families.look: Years of deferred maintenance: a rusted, leaking vehicle lift and compressor grown into one lumbering machine, peeling yellow paint, a dented tool chest for a body.
families.moves: attack: Iron Slam with the lift arm; cast: Steam Vent from a cracked hose.

families.name: The Executive Edict
families.look: A corporate decree unrolling like a scroll, navy blue with gold dots and a red seal, its ends grown into grasping paper vines that root into the floor.
families.moves: cast: Bramble Whip, the vines lash; attack: Thorn Lash.

families.name: The Unstamped Smile
families.look: A giant yellow smiley-face badge on a pin-back stalk, its smile too wide and its eyes faintly red; kindness that never weighs anything.
families.moves: cast: Choking Pollen, beams a cloying golden glow; attack: bumps forward.

families.name: The Buried Report
families.look: An office paper shredder that walks on its bin, a safety report half-swallowed in its teeth, strips of paper spilling out below.
families.moves: attack: lunges and chomps; cast: sprays shredded strips.

families.name: The CC Line
families.look: An ally among enemies: a chain of linked office phones and envelopes forming a coat-rack-like figure that reaches over every gatekeeper's head; cool white and silver.
families.moves: cast: Void Bolt, a message zips along the chain; attack: the top handset swings down.

bosses.name: Mattie-T, Store Manager
bosses.look: Mattie-T from portraits/mattie_t.jpg: bald, light-blue dress shirt and dark tie, smiling behind a desk with a computer; the man who sent the 'not ready' email before you walked in.
bosses.moves: attack: Crushing Blow (slams the keyboard); cast: Shockwave (hits Send, a purple envelope bolt); charge_ultimate: types furiously, the monitor glowing; ultimate: Cataclysm, a storm of emails swirling around him.

bosses.name: Jury, Store Manager
bosses.look: Jury from portraits/jury.jpg: short auburn hair, navy blazer, arms crossed, a wall of security monitors glowing behind her; casual malice.
bosses.moves: attack: points and says it twice (a sharp shockwave); cast: the monitors flicker and fire red scan lines; charge_ultimate: steps forward, witnesses' silhouettes behind; ultimate: Cataclysm, a grievance form slams down from above.

bosses.name: The Shingles Fire
bosses.look: The first outbreak as a boss: a towering column of nerve fire in the shape of a burning line across a forehead, blistering red and orange, flickering with pain. Appears three times, each angrier.
bosses.moves: attack: lashes; cast: flares; charge_ultimate: burns white-hot; ultimate: Cataclysm, erupts across the whole arena. p2_ (optional): the hungrier later outbreaks.

bosses.name: The Area Director
bosses.look: Corporate inspection tour: an Area Director in a sharp charcoal suit and polished shoes, with five more suits silhouetted behind (one sprite, the pack as a shadowy backdrop), a tablet held like a gavel.
bosses.moves: attack: taps the tablet, a red X slams down; cast: the suits behind all point at once; charge_ultimate: the pack gathers; ultimate: the whole inspection descends.

bosses.name: District Safety Investigator
bosses.look: A safety investigator in a hi-vis vest over a dress shirt, hard hat under one arm, sliding a rewritten report across an invisible table with a pen offered for your signature.
bosses.moves: attack: slaps the report down; cast: the pen glows, a signature line snakes toward you; ultimate: a loose wheel rolls in and the blame lands.

bosses.name: The Regional Desk
bosses.look: Built to fossilize complaints: a huge dark-wood executive desk on legs, three ringing phones and a calendar for a face, drawers that open as mouths full of stacked tickets.
bosses.moves: attack: a drawer slams out; cast: the phones ring and fire bolts; charge_ultimate: every phone lights up; ultimate: an avalanche of fossilised tickets.

bosses.name: The One-Man Close
bosses.look: Midnight, forty thousand square feet of dark: the whole store as a looming silhouette, rows of dead aisle lights, a single key glinting at its heart; the empty building pressing in.
bosses.moves: attack: the dark leans in; cast: the lights go out aisle by aisle in a wave; ultimate: every door slams at once.

bosses.name: The Parking Lot Draw
bosses.look: A dispute walking to its cars at eleven at night: two shadowy figures facing off under a sodium parking-lot light, hands hovering near their waistbands. Tense, not violent: no weapons drawn.
bosses.moves: attack: the figures surge forward; cast: headlights flare; ultimate: the light pole flickers and the tension snaps (a flash, no gunfire).

bosses.name: The Freight-to-Floor
bosses.look: The overhaul all at once: a giant freight wall golem with bins and topstock for armour and a big red countdown clock set in its chest.
bosses.moves: attack: Crushing Blow with a pallet fist; cast: boxes rain down; charge_ultimate: the clock ticks faster; ultimate: the whole rebuild collapses forward.

bosses.name: The Regional Audit
bosses.look: Pressure from above: a towering regional director in a grey suit wielding an oversized clipboard, a magnifying glass eye, checklist ribbons trailing.
bosses.moves: attack: Iron Slam with the clipboard; cast: Steam Vent, the magnifying glass focuses a hot beam; ultimate: every checkbox turns red.

bosses.name: The Overnight Meat Grinder
bosses.look: Thirteen names, numbered: a huge industrial grinder machine in the dark backroom, a conveyor belt mouth, red warning lights, worn name badges hanging off its rim like trophies (no readable names).
bosses.moves: attack: the belt drags forward; cast: the warning lights flare; charge_ultimate: the grinder revs; ultimate: Cataclysm.

bosses.name: The Relocation Contract
bosses.look: The collar that has been waiting: a long contract document coiling like a serpent, a heavy golden collar open at its head, clawback figures as scales.
bosses.moves: attack: lunges with the collar; cast: the contract tightens; ultimate: the collar snaps shut around the arena.

bosses.name: Azalia, Store Manager
bosses.look: Azalia from portraits/azalia.jpg: warm smile, short brown hair, the teal vest with smiley badge over a mustard shirt; weaponised kindness that cancels every consequence.
bosses.moves: attack: a gentle pat that hits like a hammer; cast: beams a golden smile that dissolves a write-up; ultimate: a flood of smiley badges.

bosses.name: Jay-Dau, Store Manager
bosses.look: Jay-Dau from portraits/jay_dau.jpg: bald, big grin, teal vest over a dark shirt, a stack of quarterly reports under one hand; friend by daylight, hell on the clock.
bosses.moves: attack: slams the reports; cast: the grin flips to a glare; p2_ (optional): the friendly face gone. Ultimate: quarterly pressure crashing down.

bosses.name: Amandy, Store Lead
bosses.look: Amandy from portraits/amandy.jpg: dark hair pulled back, teal vest, a walkie-talkie raised, arms crossed; the screaming assistant manager at full tilt.
bosses.moves: attack: shouts into the radio (a red shockwave); cast: fire, the redone plan flung at you; ultimate: a screaming storm of demands.

bosses.name: Sriniviii, Store Manager
bosses.look: Sriniviii from portraits/sriniviii.jpg: neat dark hair, teal vest over a white shirt, hands clasped, a polite smile; the morning verdict after every overnight.
bosses.moves: attack: a sharp gesture; cast: wheels the goalposts away; ultimate: the verdict lands.

bosses.name: Abdoolie, Store Manager
bosses.look: Abdoolie from portraits/abdoolie.jpg: thin, grey work shirt with the smiley badge, hands at his sides, a cold stillness and flat declarative stare; he sounds like Ohmar.
bosses.moves: attack: a pause, then a cold strike; cast: a ripple of silence; ultimate: the cadence repeats until the room freezes.

bosses.name: Ohmar, the Store Lead
bosses.look: Ohmar from portraits/ohmar.jpg: the biggest man in the building, dark turban, black polo with the smiley badge, arms folded, a stillness that does the threatening. Never shouts.
bosses.moves: windup: leans forward, arms still folded; attack: Heavy Slam, a hand flat on the table; cast: Shockwave, a flat declarative stare that ripples out; charge_ultimate: the closed door, the formal chair, the pause before the question; ultimate: Cataclysm, the voice never rises and the room freezes.

bosses.name: The Asphalt Gauntlet
bosses.look: A hundred miles of headlights: a hulking golem of stacked orange-and-white construction barriers and traffic cones on a cracked asphalt base, reflective tape striping its body, two brake-light red eyes, a road sign bent into each fist.
bosses.moves: windup: the barrier stack sways, hazard lights blinking; attack: Crushing Blow, a barrier arm slams down; cast: Shockwave, a wave of headlight glare rolls out; charge_ultimate: every light on its body flashes amber, brakes squealing; ultimate: Cataclysm, the whole stack topples forward like a pile-up.

bosses.name: The Moving Goalposts
bosses.look: A yellow American-football goalpost bolted to a rolling cart, wheels squealing as it rolls away just as you reach it; a little grin on the crossbar.
bosses.moves: windup: rolls back, wheels squealing; attack: Crushing Blow, rams forward on its wheels; cast: Shockwave, the crossbar rings like a bell; charge_ultimate: the cart rolls back further and further out of reach; ultimate: Cataclysm, the goalpost slams down as the cart charges through.

bosses.name: The Ownerless Building
bosses.look: The store four hours after close: a dark storefront facade on stubby legs, the automatic doors a closed mouth, one aisle light left on for an eye.
bosses.moves: windup: the facade leans in, doors grinding; attack: Crushing Blow, the facade slams; cast: Shockwave, the lights flicker off in a cold wave; charge_ultimate: every aisle light goes dark but the one eye; ultimate: Cataclysm, the doors lock and the whole front falls in.

bosses.name: The Fourth Signal
bosses.look: The body's scorecard: a writhing line of nerve fire shaped like a creature, red-orange blisters along its back, an angry glow; it hurts to look at.
bosses.moves: windup: the nerve line coils, blisters glowing; attack: Crushing Blow, lashes like a whip of fire; cast: Shockwave, flares outward; charge_ultimate: the whole body burns white-hot along one side; ultimate: Cataclysm, a searing line of fire runs the length of the field.

bosses.name: The Redemption Schedule
bosses.look: Thousands owed for walking away: a floating payment table on yellowed parchment, rows of figures in cold blue ink, a heavy iron chain and padlock dangling from it, a signature line curling like a smile. Hovers.
bosses.moves: windup: the chain swings; attack: Crushing Blow, the chain lashes; cast: Shockwave, the figures peel off as cold blue bolts; charge_ultimate: the totals add up, the padlock glows; ultimate: Cataclysm, the chain wraps the whole party and the lock snaps shut.

bosses.name: The Alternative
bosses.look: The 3 AM visitor from the darkest chapter: a quiet, tall shadow in the shape of a person, edges dissolving like smoke, offering one open hand. Keep it abstract and still: no weapons, no wounds, nothing graphic. Its power is the silence around it.
bosses.moves: windup: the shadow grows taller and more still; attack: Crushing Blow, reaches out slowly; cast: Shockwave, the darkness around it swells (no projectile); charge_ultimate: the room goes silent, the open hand waits; ultimate: Cataclysm, a wave of quiet darkness (abstract, nothing graphic); death: fades into morning light (the player refuses it).

bosses.name: The Parting Shot
bosses.look: 'He'll be out in two months anyway': a crumpled grey office note on folded paper legs, a smudged signature for a sneer, its edges whispering into paper wisps that travel down the hall.
bosses.moves: windup: the note unfolds, muttering; attack: Crushing Blow, wraps the target like an envelope; cast: Shockwave, fires a hiss of paper cuts; charge_ultimate: the whisper spreads, more notes fluttering in; ultimate: Cataclysm, a storm of crumpled notes.

bosses.name: The Pay Cut
bosses.look: Twenty-four thousand reasons to doubt yourself: a grey, leaden machine built from a rusted vehicle lift and a counterweight, a huge iron weight hanging from its arm, a dented tool chest for a body.
bosses.moves: windup: the weight swings back; attack: Crushing Blow, Iron Slam with the lift arm; cast: Shockwave, steam vents from a cracked hose; charge_ultimate: the weight rises to the top of the lift, chains straining; ultimate: Cataclysm, the weight drops.

bosses.name: The Final Balance Sheet
bosses.look: Everything the machine cost and could not take: an office shredder walking on its bin with a thick ledger book in its teeth, green and red columns spilling out as strips below.
bosses.moves: windup: the blades whir up; attack: Crushing Blow, lunges and chomps; cast: Shockwave, sprays shredded strips; charge_ultimate: the ledger pages flip fast, columns glowing red; ultimate: Cataclysm, the final total slams down.

bosses.name: The Customer Gauntlet
bosses.look: The entitled and the abusive: a lumpy wall of furious shoppers fused into one red-faced mass, many fists raised holding receipts, phones and return bags, mouths open mid-complaint, a 'SPEAK TO YOUR MANAGER' energy to the whole shape.
bosses.moves: windup: the mass leans back, fists rising; attack: the whole mass surges forward; cast: War Cry, a roar of complaints; charge_ultimate: every phone comes up recording; ultimate: the whole crowd crashes over the counter.

bosses.name: Aussie
bosses.look: Aussie from portraits/aussie.jpg: stocky, scowling, navy polo, lanyard badge, clipboard with an angry spreadsheet; the absentee salaried manager who only has one tool, the collective threat.
bosses.moves: windup: taps the clipboard, scowling; attack: Crushing Blow, smacks the clipboard down; cast: Shockwave, waves the spreadsheet, red cells flying out; charge_ultimate: flips to the last page, the collective threat in red; ultimate: Cataclysm, the spreadsheet explodes into a storm of red cells.

bosses.name: The Man They Wanted
bosses.look: Upper management's favourite answer: a tall man in a black suit and red tie with no face at all, just smooth shadow, a briefcase in hand.
bosses.moves: windup: the faceless head tilts; attack: briefcase swing; cast: Siphon Essence, drains light from the room; charge_ultimate: the briefcase opens, shadow pouring out; ultimate: the shadow swallows the field and the light comes back slowly.

notes: Adriana's Inspiration fights in 36 encounters as a recolour of Adriana; draw her own sheet (a floating, glowing pose set) if the recolour isn't enough.
